risk_if_not_implemented: Without Indicators of Compromise (IOC), malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Threat Intelligence Feeds
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain situational awareness of vulnerabilities and evolving threats by leveraging the knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques and procedures to facilitate the implementation of preventative and compensating controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Threat Intelligence Feeds (THR-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Indicators of Compromise (IOC) (IRO-05) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Indicators of Compromise (IOC) (IRO-05) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
